instruction: Download and install the Numix GTK theme from gnome-look.org, then apply it to my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Similar to original task but installs Numix theme instead of Orchis. Uses same evaluator pattern - checks gtk-theme setting via gsettings for 'Numix' string. No custom functions needed as check_list metric is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the final state: GTK theme is set to Numix via gsettings
Data flow is semantically correct: gsettings outputs theme name -> cache_file getter reads it -> check_list metric searches for 'Numix' regex pattern
The regex pattern 'Numix' will successfully match gsettings output format (e.g., 'Numix' with quotes)
State accessibility is robust: gsettings can be queried at any time without requiring UI dialogs or special state

While the evaluator doesn't verify intermediate steps (download/install), it correctly verifies the end goal (theme applied), which is a valid verification approach since an applied theme must have been installed
